title: 178 L Direct Cool Refrigerator 2 Star Royal Red
category: Home Appliances > Refrigerators > Direct Cool Refrigerator
key_features: Fast Ice Making : Wide freezer with a powerful compressor in Lloyd refrigerator helps maintain better cooling and thus it makes ice faster than any other product in its segment
Fleximax Design : Adjustable glass shelves to help you use space inside the refrigerator efficiently according to your needs and provide multiple storage spaces for items of different shapes & sizes

Concealed Capillary & Suction (CCS) : The concealed capillary & suction technology enhances cooling by keeping the refrigerants in the body of the refrigerator. It improves the cooling efficiency of Lloyd refrigerators
Quick Chilling Zone : A specialized zone for Quick Chilling and this zone is perfect to store milk packets and other dairy products
Antibacterial Gasket : Health-friendly gasket that keeps bacteria out and maintains hygiene inside
Stabilizer Free Operation : This refrigerator works without stabilizer, with wide voltage range
Big Bottle Storage : Taller items like bottles can be easliy accommodated in the large door baskets. You can easily store enough number of cold beverages in refrigerator door section
Low Noise : Technologically advanced compressor and superior build quality results in lower noise level
